headline: Chinese Refiners Pivot to African and Brazilian Crude Amid Falling Freight Rates
summary: Chinese oil refiners are increasing crude purchases from West Africa and Brazil as declining tanker freight rates make Atlantic Basin supplies more attractive.
why: Shifts in maritime crude sourcing alter global shipping routes, freight demand, and pricing dynamics for Atlantic and Russian oil grades.

impacts.name: Oil & Gas
impacts.why: Diverting crude imports toward African and Brazilian suppliers affects global tanker utilization and regional export volumes.
